description: Trim PDF margins: set crop margins in inches per edge on all pages or a page range, with a live margin preview in your browser.

faqs.a: It sets the PDF crop box — the content outside your margins is hidden from view and print, but the original data stays in the file.
Enter ranges like 1-3,5 or leave the field empty for all pages.
faqs.q: Can I crop only some pages?

faqs.a: Everything is processed locally in your browser with PDF-Lib. Your files are never uploaded to any server.

howto: Enter margin sizes in inches for top, right, bottom and left.
Optionally limit cropping to a page range (e.g. 1-3,5).
title: PDF Page Cropper
